name: job_duration_ms
description: JOB_FINISHED total_duration_ms on a job's first finish (prior_finishes=0): created_at to done/failed/paused, including time waiting for the user to confirm parts.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="bharat-sourcer-integration" AND jsonPayload.event="JOB_FINISHED" AND jsonPayload.prior_finishes=0

name: job_finished_count
description: Every JOB_FINISHED line (first finishes and re-finishes after resume, refresh or re-confirm).

labels.description: error code when failed (bounded set of ExtractionError/job codes); empty otherwise

name: gemini_call_duration_ms
description: GEMINI_CALL duration_ms per routed generateContent call (retries included).

name: gemini_cost_usd
description: GEMINI_USAGE usd_est per call: an estimate from tokens and search queries, not Google's bill. Use the _sum series for spend.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="bharat-sourcer-integration" AND jsonPayload.event="GEMINI_USAGE" AND jsonPayload.usd_est>=0

name: stage_duration_ms
description: STAGE_FINISHED duration_ms per pipeline stage run.

name: seller_fetch_count
description: SELLER_FETCH lines (seller pages and searches), by outcome.

labels.description: ok, http_error, cache, cooldown, blocked, robots, timeout, api_route, error

name: app_errors
description: App log lines at ERROR or above (including UNHANDLED_ERROR and PROXY_ERROR) on both services. Cloud Run request-log lines are excluded; 5xx responses have their own alert.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=("bharat-sourcer-integration" OR "bharat-sourcer-web") AND NOT log_id("run.googleapis.com/requests") AND (severity>=ERROR OR jsonPayload.event="UNHANDLED_ERROR" OR jsonPayload.event="PROXY_ERROR")

name: api_request_count
description: API requests from the Cloud Run request log, excluding /internal/* (Cloud Tasks work answers 503 on purpose to retry) and SSE /stream requests. Used for API availability and the API 5xx alert.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="bharat-sourcer-integration" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/requests") AND NOT httpRequest.requestUrl:"/internal/" AND NOT httpRequest.requestUrl:"/stream"

name: api_request_latency
description: API request latency in seconds from the Cloud Run request log, excluding /internal/* and SSE /stream requests. Used for the latency SLO and alerts.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="bharat-sourcer-integration" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/requests") AND NOT httpRequest.requestUrl:"/internal/" AND NOT httpRequest.requestUrl:"/stream"
